template.name: acltable
template.description: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE over a physical object

templates.template: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ${catalog}.${name} AS ${db}.${schema}.${table} COLUMNS (${columns}) RLS (${predicate});${cursor}

template.name: aclview
template.description: CREATE VIRTUAL VIEW (a SELECT in physical names)

templates.template: GRANT CATALOG ${catalog} TO ROLE ${role} WITH (select) MAIN;${cursor}

template.name: aclgrantobject
template.description: GRANT OBJECT with a row filter and columns

templates.template: GRANT OBJECT ${catalog}.${name} TO ROLE ${role} WITH (select) RLS (${predicate}) COLUMNS (${columns});${cursor}
ALTER GRANT CATALOG ${catalog} TO ROLE ${role} SET CAPS '{"select": true}';${cursor}

template.name: aclcheck
template.description: CHECK VIRTUAL CATALOG: what drifted from the source, with the repair

template.name: aclviewas
template.description: SET SESSION VIEW AS ROLE: the catalog as a role sees it (metadata only)
